name: geotech-references
summary: Digitized geotechnical reference library: 33 packages of callable functions and structured text, including DM 7.1/7.2, FHWA GEC-4 to GEC-14, the FHWA Soils and Foundations and Pavements manuals, micropiles, the UFC pavement and structural criteria, AASHTO 1993, Eurocode 7, EM 1110-2-2104/2107, FEMA P-2082, wood handbook and the Caltrans Trenching and Shoring Manual
